summary: Implemented the rich_measure for Tree and rich.align.VerticalCenter feature. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative, explicit stack, level counter, returns Measurement); rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, a width constraint in Align.__rich_console__ (measured maximum, or min with explicit width), and the new VerticalCenter class with repr, newline-padded rendering using console.size.height, and measurement; rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options while still passing justify into _collect_renderables; CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as Unreleased with an Added section. Tests added in tests/test_align.py (repr, VerticalCenter render and measure) and tests/test_tree.py (acceptance tree measures Measurement(11, 19)); tests/test_tree.py also gained a top-level `import io`, which the spec did not list. Tests were NOT run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. No commits made.
